assumptions.statement: Official FAR, height, density, setbacks, green ratio, fire, and heritage-view controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Massing and land-use organization are conceptual; no statutory development rights are claimed.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary is a repository-supplied provisional rough polygon.
assumptions.impact: Areas and ratios are reproducible from this polygon but are not official survey or redline values.

assumptions.statement: Three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry.
assumptions.impact: Detailed-design locations and areas must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines, sections, station interfaces, and traffic survey data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Mobility lines express connections, not engineering alignments or approved sections.

assumptions.statement: Parcel, ownership, existing-building survey, and structural appraisal data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/new-infill tags are design hypotheses requiring field survey and owner consultation.

assumptions.statement: Complete heritage-control and archaeological data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All work near the railway heritage spine requires specialist review before design development.

assumptions.statement: Utility capacity, drainage, flood, energy, fire, and underground-space records are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure actions are service briefs rather than engineering commitments.

assumptions.statement: No scenario is deployed and no energy, accuracy, adoption, or service baseline has been measured.
assumptions.impact: Every AI proposal is a testable concept with manual fallback, human review, and a stop rule.
